summary: Since round 6, the only change is clearer README wording about the cutover: `prod` receives no traffic until DNS points `gethalo.dev` at it. That wording is accurate, the infra source is unchanged, and every changed line is covered. The change cannot be approved because `releases/.tmp-tests/promoteRelease.test.mjs` is back in the temp run for the third time, and all 10 of its tests fail.

findings.body: The temp test run fails for the third time. `releases/.tmp-tests/promoteRelease.test.mjs` has reappeared in this branch's worktree, and all 10 tests fail with ENOENT at line 43 (`promoteFixture`) when copying `releases/promotion.mjs`. That file is not in this branch. The test belongs to PR 422. The other suites pass: electron 4/4, infra 7/7, and config 11/11. Removing the file only from the run has not held, because it keeps coming back into this worktree. Delete `releases/.tmp-tests/` from this worktree and keep it only in PR 422's worktree, so later rounds do not pick it up again.
